title: An Empirical Study on the Bugs Found while Reusing Pre-trained Natural Language Processing Models

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of GitHub issues to identify bugs where improper natural language specification during model reuse (such as translating from a non-gendered language like English to a gender-specific language like Spanish) causes the model to default to male representations.

Analyzing bug reports and hyperparameter configurations to demonstrate how setting an extremely small batch size causes models to overfit to word frequencies in the dataset, leading to robustness issues and sample bias.
